verdict.rationale: Sentry's first-party docs say sentry-cli manages debug information files for iOS and Android and can validate and upload them, so Sentry can extract stack traces from crash reports on compiled platforms. A community comment separately credits Sentry's open-source Symbolicator as months of specialized work. Missing for 10: explicit naming of dSYM and ProGuard mapping file uploads, explicit evidence that stack traces resolve to function names and line numbers, and hands-on corroboration of mobile/native symbolication results.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload dSYM, ProGuard, and native debug symbols so mobile and native crashes symbolicate to real function names and lines

citations.quote: It’s primarily used for managing debug information files for iOS, Android, release and source maps management
Debug information files allow Sentry to extract stack traces and provide more information about crash reports for most compiled platforms.
sentry-cli can be used to validate and upload debug information files.
competitors such as Embrace use Sentry's open-source Symbolicator, which represents months of highly specialized work
